title: How many colors your screen shows

yt.title: Your screen shows {c_n} colors. Here is why #Shorts
yt.description:
Each pixel mixes red, green and blue, 256 levels each: 256 x 256 x 256 = {c_n}.
Narration is AI-generated.

scenes.text: Your screen shows millions of colors
scenes.narration: Your screen can show millions of colors. Here is exactly how many, and why.

scenes.label: colors from 3 numbers
scenes.narration: Every pixel mixes red, green, and blue. Each one has two hundred fifty six levels. Multiply them: {c_n_say} colors.
Two fifty six, three times. One byte per color, three bytes per pixel.
